research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Blockdaemon is researching systems for blockchain operation authorization and verification, as described in a system where a remote server generates operation payloads for on-premises nodes to execute blockchain operations. Additionally, they are developing multi-party computation node configuration, involving client devices and multiple MPC nodes that jointly execute operations based on user input. These areas reflect a focus on secure blockchain operation management and collaborative computation.

overview_description.description: Blockdaemon is the institutional gateway to Web3, securing over $110B in digital assets for 400+ institutions, including exchanges, custodians, crypto platforms, and financial enterprises. We offer institutional-grade blockchain infrastructure spanning nodes, APIs, earn, staking, MPC wallets and vaults. Since 2017, our globally distributed infrastructure ensures unrivaled security, compliance, and scalability. For more information visit: www.blockdaemon.com

about_short_description.short_description: The institutional gateway to Web3, Blockdaemon secures $110B+ in digital assets for 400+ exchanges, custodians, and financial institutions.

product.name: Institutional Vault
product.description: An MPC-based wallet and vault for institutional digital-asset custody, transaction approval, and hot or cold storage.

product.name: Staking Infrastructure
product.description: Managed validators, staking services, and APIs that enable institutions to participate in proof-of-stake networks and manage rewards.

product.name: Earn Stack
product.description: A widget, API, and vault-based platform for embedding staking and DeFi yield products without building the underlying infrastructure.

product.name: Builder Vault
product.description: A customizable MPC wallet platform for organizations building branded custodial or self-custody Web3 wallets in cloud or on-premises environments.

product.name: RPC API
product.description: API access to blockchain nodes for submitting transactions and querying on-chain data across supported networks.

product.name: Dedicated Nodes and Node Clusters
product.description: Managed blockchain nodes and high-availability clusters with scaling, failover, routing, and protocol-specific infrastructure support.
